en.title: Manchester City won 4-1 against Inter in Women's Champions League
en.dek: Aoba Fujino scored twice in the 4-1 victory for Manchester City in Monza.
facts: Manchester City scored four goals against Inter in Monza on 10 November 2026.
Aoba Fujino scored two goals for Manchester City before half-time.
Kerstin Casparij and Grace Clinton scored in the second half, resulting in a 4-1 victory.
Manchester City recorded its first Women's Champions League victory of the season according to The Guardian.
body: Manchester City scored four goals against Inter in Monza on 10 November 2026, recording its first Women's Champions League victory of the season according to The Guardian.
Aoba Fujino scored two goals for Manchester City before half-time, which put the team ahead before the break.

Kerstin Casparij and Grace Clinton scored in the second half, securing the 4-1 result which doubled Manchester City's points tally after previous draws against Bayern Munich, Real Madrid, and Paris Saint-Germain.
Andrée Jeglertz rested Khadija ‘Bunny’ Shaw, Lauren Hemp, and Yui Hasegawa ahead of a meeting with Chelsea on Saturday.

en.imageCaption: Aoba Fujino of Manchester City scores their first goal against Inter. Photograph: Declan Lloyd/Manchester City FC/Getty Images

ja.title: マンチェスター・シティ、女子チャンピオンズリーグでインテルに4-1で勝利
ja.dek: 藤野青葉が2得点を記録し、マンチェスター・シティはモンツァで4-1で勝利した
facts: マンチェスター・シティは2026年11月10日にモンツァでインテルに4得点を記録した
藤野青葉は前半までにマンチェスター・シティのために2得点を挙げた
ケルスティン・カスパリイとグレース・クリントンが後半に得点を挙げ、4-1で勝利した
ガーディアン紙によると、マンチェスター・シティはこのシーズン初の女子チャンピオンズリーグでの勝利を記録した
body: マンチェスター・シティは2026年11月10日、モンツァで行われたインテル戦で4-1と勝利し、今シーズンの女子チャンピオンズリーグ初勝利を収めたとガーディアン紙が報じた。
藤野青葉は前半に2得点を挙げ、チームをリードした。
カースティン・カスパリとグレース・クリントンが後半に得点を重ね、4-1の勝利を確定させた。これにより、バイエルン・ミュンヘン、レアル・マドリード、パリ・サンジェルマンとの過去の引き分けを経て、マンチェスター・シティの勝ち点は倍増した。
アンドレ・イェグルツは、土曜日のチェルシー戦に際し、ハディジャ・シャウ、ローレン・ヘンプ、長谷川結衣を休養させた。
ja.imageCaption: マンチェスター・シティの藤野青葉がインテル相手に先制点を決める。写真：Declan Lloyd/Manchester City FC/Getty Images

pt.title: Manchester City venceu por 4-1 contra o Inter na Liga dos Campeões Feminina
pt.dek: Aoba Fujino marcou dois golos na vitória por 4-1 do Manchester City em Monza
facts: Manchester City marcou quatro golos contra o Inter em Monza a 10 de novembro de 2026
Aoba Fujino marcou dois golos para o Manchester City antes do intervalo
Kerstin Casparij e Grace Clinton marcaram na segunda parte, resultando numa vitória por 4-1
O Manchester City registou a sua primeira vitória na Liga dos Campeões Feminina da época segundo The Guardian
body: Manchester City venceu a Inter por 4-1 em Monza a 10 de novembro de 2026, registando a sua primeira vitória na Liga dos Campeões Feminina da época, segundo The Guardian.
Aoba Fujino marcou dois golos para o Manchester City antes do intervalo, colocando a equipa na frente antes da pausa.

Kerstin Casparij e Grace Clinton marcaram na segunda metade, assegurando o resultado de 4-1, que duplicou o total de pontos do Manchester City após empates anteriores contra Bayern Munique, Real Madrid e Paris Saint-Germain.
Andrée Jeglertz descansou Khadija ‘Bunny’ Shaw, Lauren Hemp e Yui Hasegawa antes do encontro com o Chelsea no sábado.
pt.context: The CBS Sports Trade Chart was invented more than fifteen seasons ago to help fantasy managers make fair trades in their leagues.
pt.imageCaption: Aoba Fujino do Manchester City marca o primeiro golo contra o Inter. Fotografia: Declan Lloyd/Manchester City FC/Getty Images

problemsFixed: The headline is not a factual statement of what happened and contains unnecessary phrasing.
The dek is not a single-sentence summary under 30 words.
The facts list contains unsupported claims regarding the NFL trade chart (e.g., specific rankings for Jefferson/Nacua are not detailed, only that the chart exists and what it measures).
The body contains unsupported claims about Jeglertz's delight and uses non-neutral framing.
The context contains speculation about why the chart is updated (e.g., 'to help fantasy managers adjust rosters') which is not a direct fact from the source, only what the chart is for.

The structure does not adhere to the required rhythm (varying sentence length, no four short declarative sentences in a row) and paragraph opening rules (open with actor/number/date, not the same noun as the previous paragraph).
